title: Configuration profile
description: A profile (PRF) configures the same R1 model for an organization stage, a complexity tier, a service tier, or a customer segment. A profile may require additional fields, add gate evidence, mark waivable gate evidence optional (a lighter gate), change gate formality, and override listed rule parameters. A profile cannot redefine the lifecycle (it has no field for phases, order, or legal moves), change ID semantics, introduce AI authority, remove a gate's human-recorded outcome or approver role, change readiness weights or categories, or disable a rule that the rule's own stage_behavior marks required for the profile's organization stage. tools/validate.py enforces each limit. When two profiles applied to one project override the same rule field, the later profile in the order org_stage, complexity, service, segment wins. Examples are illustrative examples using synthetic data.

org_stage.description: Required when profile_type is org_stage; the stage from standard/org-stages.yaml.

required_fields.description: Fields that become required for records of projects using this profile. Each must be a property of that entity's R1 schema. A profile only adds requirements; the schema minimum always applies.

gate_adjustments.description: Changes to gate evidence and formality. The outcome is always recorded by a named human.

additional_evidence_types.description: Artifact types from lifecycle/lifecycle.yaml added to the gate (a heavier gate).

optional_evidence_types.description: Required evidence made optional (a lighter gate). Only evidence that lifecycle/gates.yaml marks waivable_by_profile.

approver_role.description: A role key from lifecycle/lifecycle.yaml. Changes who approves; never removes the approver.

parameter_overrides.description: Overrides of listed rule parameters. Each value is a proposed design value, not a measured result, and a user-configurable parameter.

examples.name: Complexity tier: standard
examples.description: Illustrative example of a complexity profile.
